turns.q: How do I use it properly the very first time?
turns.replyTail:
Using your new shift dress is as simple as putting it on! Since the UPF 50+ sun protection is built directly into the fabric, it provides instant coverage blocking 98% of UVA and UVB rays as soon as you wear it.
For care, machine wash it or hand wash on a gentle cycle, and lay it flat to dry in the shade. Avoid using the dryer, hang drying, or applying sunscreens that contain avobenzone to protect the fabric and maintain its sun-protective qualities.
